name: Mercado Biológico do Porto
description: Spend your Saturday morning at the city's organic market. Stock up on seasonal vegetables, artisanal goat cheese, sourdough bread, and more from local producers.
longDescription:
The Mercado Biológico do Porto is a regular open-air market dedicated to organic produce and artisanal goods, held at Parque da Cidade. This event provides a platform for local farmers and small-scale producers to offer their certified organic fruits, vegetables, and other food items directly to the public. The market aims to promote sustainable agriculture and provide access to fresh, locally sourced ingredients within the city.

Visitors can expect a relaxed atmosphere, suitable for a Saturday morning outing. The market typically features a selection of stalls selling seasonal produce, baked goods, dairy products such as goat cheese, and other specialty items. The outdoor setting of Parque da Cidade offers a spacious environment for browsing and interacting with vendors. The event is generally family-friendly and open to all ages.

Entry to the Mercado Biológico do Porto is free. The market is easily accessible via public transport; several bus lines serve Parque da Cidade. It is a walk-in event, and no prior booking is required.
